properties.name: Full-text search moves to Tantivy 0.27, with no code change and no index rebuild
properties.rationale: Under req:reflow2-keeps-its-dependencies-at-or-near-their-latest-releases a new 0.x series gets its own change that adapts the code; on Anthony's word 2026-10-17 ("Bump PR first") it is its own commit inside the v0.86.0 cut (PR #766) rather than its own PR, because only one design PR can hold reflow2's design at a time. MEASURED, not assumed: cargo dev-test with 0.27, 3,237 passed and 0 failed; a store whose index tantivy 0.26 built (reflow2's own design imported by the 0.86.0 cut build, 7,513 nodes) was opened by the 0.27 release build, every index file stayed byte-identical, loop_status reported no search_index_rebuilt_on_open, and four searches returned the same hits with the same scores on both builds; a small store written to by 0.27 (adding a second segment) was then read in full by the 0.26 build, so rollback loses no search. dependency_currency.py after the bump: OK. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: tantivy 0.26 -> 0.27 (the new 0.x series published 2026-10-17 at 11:17 UTC, which turned the v0.86.0 cut's dependency-currency check red). No reflow2 code changed: none of 0.27's API breaks touch what foundation/text.rs calls. The index format is unchanged (INDEX_FORMAT_VERSION 7 in both), so the rebuild-on-open check does not fire and a store's index is kept as it is. The lock also moves zstd-sys 2.1.0 -> 2.1.2 through zstd 0.14.
